status: Synthetic finite-record oracle/demo only; no model evaluation.
assumptions: Claim kinds/proposition ASTs are hand-authored gold; no natural-language semantic parser exists.
Event issuer identity and source policies are trusted simulation inputs, not inferred from notice wording.
Retraction archives a source assertion; supersession preserves the old assertion and adds an owner-scoped replacement.
Private world truth is separate annotation and is never consulted by the evidence-status oracle.
No erasure experiment is included. All identities, reports, commits and private worlds are fictional.
